blind.description: A stylized medieval or military equipment wall rack featuring a horizontal wooden plank with metal end brackets and five pegs. Hanging from the pegs are two domed metal helmets, a red cloak with gold border trim, a brown leather belt with a brass buckle, and a brown leather satchel bag with straps. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with hand-painted PBR materials. The entire asset hovers in the air since it is designed to be mounted onto a wall.
blind.from_above: A narrow horizontal wooden beam with five pegs protruding outward along the front edge, showing the rounded tops of two metal helmets, folds of the red cloth, and the top of a small satchel.
defects: floats in mid-air without a supporting wall
blind.height_vs_figure: The rack assembly hangs at about mid-height (~4 ft off the ground), measuring roughly 2 ft tall from the beam to the bottom of the cloak and about 3.5 ft wide (around half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure).
